root_idea.summary: The root centers on proceeding forward without turning aside or stopping.
root_idea.development: From this orientation come meanings of continuous journeying and exertion, while diversion or heedlessness is understood as proceeding along in one's activity without pausing or attending elsewhere.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular active-participle citation form سَامِدٌ rather than the Quranic plural surface form.

senses.definition: One who amuses himself, plays, or engages in diversion.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic plural سَامِدُونَ; the usage denotes being occupied in amusement or diversion rather than attentive engagement.

senses.definition: One who is negligent, inattentive, heedless, or distracted.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic interpretation of سَامِدُونَ emphasizing failure to attend or heed rather than deliberate amusement.

senses.definition: A singer, or one engaged in singing.
senses.usage_conditions: One of the explicit interpretations reported for the Quranic plural سَامِدُونَ.

senses.definition: One who raises the head, especially in proud self-display.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic usage is explained through the posture of holding the head high and behaving proudly.

senses.definition: One standing confused, perplexed, or amazed, including amazement arising from exuberant joy.
senses.usage_conditions: An explicit interpretation of the plural in the Quranic passage; this sense concerns a state of bewilderment or astonishment, not merely heedlessness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become high or elevated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A basic intransitive use describing elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand with the head raised and the breast erect; of a stallion, to stand thus in sexual excitement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The erect posture is a conventional descriptive use and is distinct from the Quranic interpretation of proud self-display.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain constantly devoted to an affair, or to remain upon the ground or in the land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A use expressing persistence or continued presence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strive, labor, or exert oneself in work or journeying; of camels, to press on in travel without fatigue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used both of exertion generally and of sustained movement in a journey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To direct oneself toward, seek, or aim at someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction equivalent in sense to directing oneself toward or seeking a goal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make land or ground plain, smooth, or soft.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use applied to ground or land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divert or entertain him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II use; it may involve entertaining by means of singing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To manure or dung the land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is land or soil, with سَمَادٌ as the applied manure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove all of the hair by shaving it off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II use also recorded as a dialectal variant of the corresponding use of سَبَّدَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave off anointing oneself or one's hair and washing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A usage in which the object of the verbal noun is understood from context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become swollen or greatly swollen; of a person, to become swollen with anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same use is applied to an arm, hand, leg, or foot when it becomes inflated and swollen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go or pass away, or to perish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can also describe perishing as a result of anger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Continuing or unceasing journeying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use describing uninterrupted travel or movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ever, perpetually, or for ever.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adverbially in expressions of unending duration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Compost or manure made from animal dung with ashes, earth, or dust, or from strong earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A material used for enriching land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fine or white flour, fine bread, or a wheat-based food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry records variant explanations and orthographic uncertainty concerning the final consonant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man or animal raising its head; one standing with the head raised and the breast erect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the general participial description, apart from the specifically Quran-attested interpretation of proud self-display.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Silent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Classical Arabic adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grieving or mourning, and lowly, humble, or submissive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported emotional or behavioral use associated with grief or mourning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Continuing in journeying or striving; of camels, pressing on or exerting themselves in travel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial use, especially in descriptions of camels continuing through the night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a milk-skin or similar vessel, full so that it stands upright.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative or tropical use applied to a وَطْب, a skin used for holding milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An Arabicized term for a kind of white or fine bread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source treats its relation to سَمِيدٌ as uncertain and describes it as a borrowed term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A basket made from palm leaves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is explained as a basket probably used for carrying manure.

cautions: The sole Quran occurrence is the plural سَامِدُونَ; the public headword is normalized to the singular active-participle citation form سَامِدٌ.

The Quranic occurrence has several explicitly reported interpretations, including diversion, heedlessness, singing, proud head-raising, and confused amazement; these are retained as distinct senses rather than collapsed into the contextual gloss alone.
